P27-AC-02.details: Sample TINIX_CAPCUT_IMPORT_TEST fully indexed with exact SHA256 hashes (draft, video 1011.mp4, effectStyle.json, AnimScript.lua, MPLUS1p-ExtraBold.ttf, artistEffect content.json). P27-AC-03.details: 19 feature options mapped to Core, Extended, and Unsupported tiers with designated owner phases (P29-P35) and explicit test scenarios. Validation bounds and .tinixtpl template pack format locked.

P27-AC-04.criterion: Units, grapheme/span indexing, layout và duration/lifecycle semantics không còn mơ hồ
P27-AC-04.details: Canonical RationalTime { value: i64, rate: FrameRate } locked; three-tier transform hierarchy (Item -> Layer -> Unit) and 2D matrix multiplication order locked; painter's order (background -> shadows/glows -> outer strokes -> glyph fill -> inner strokes) and units defined; character defined strictly as Unicode UAX #29 extended grapheme cluster; rich text span indexing defined by grapheme offsets with deterministic rebinding on ClipTextSet; duration collision resolution defined with rejection by default and explicit ProportionalScale/ClampOut options; editorial Move/Trim/Split/Stretch rules, parameter whitelist, and .tinixtpl archive safety limits locked.

P27-AC-05.criterion: Fixture corpus và comparison policy kiểm tra được tiếng Việt/alpha/timing/overrides
P27-AC-05.details: 14 fixtures (F01-F14) defined covering exact CapCut recreation with text variants ('Tinix', 'Hi'), Vietnamese NFC/NFD diacritics, ZWJ emoji, multiline, edge cases, Latin ligatures, CJK/RTL boundaries, multi-stroke/shadow stress, gradients, duration collision policies (reject vs proportional), responsive canvas anchors across 4 aspect ratios and 5 frame rates, rich spans + background box/glow, multilayer density stress (16 layers), and full in/loop/out lifecycle with 8 standard sampling checkpoints.
